Luke — forwarding a short ops snippet for your engineers.

--- ops runbook snippet ---
- Normal: EU primary serves traffic; KV cache and prefix-caching active in EU.
- Replication: async snapshot and incremental KV sync to APAC standby every 45s; topology ensures eventual consistency for non-critical state.
- Failover trigger: automated on health-checks (loss of >30% EU capacity or region-level networking outage) OR manual by MediPrime on the console.
- Failover path: APAC nodes promoted to warm-standby; traffic routed via Redwood smart-routing with weighted DNS shift and in-flight prefix rehydration; expected cold-start tail for first 30s, then SLA target <500ms at 95th pct.
- Rollback: immediate rollback to EU with prefix cache rehydration from snapshot; we run smoke tests 5/5 endpoints before closing incident.
- Kickoff & test: recommend a planned DR drill during a low-traffic window (we can assist).

If that matches what you need, Karthik (ops) can provide the sequence diagram and exact route table fragments for procurement/audit.

—Ben
